product.name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Gen, USB-C)
product.productType: True Wireless Stereo (TWS) In-Ear Noise-Cancelling Earbuds
product.description: Eliminates distracting ambient noise, automatic voice/volume adjustment during chats, sweat/dust resistance (IP54 rating for both buds and case), effortless multi-device switching across Apple devices

specifications.Product Type: True Wireless Stereo (TWS) In-Ear Noise-Cancelling Earbuds

product.rawSpecs:
Specifications        
• Dimensions (each earbud): 30.9 × 21.8 × 24.0 mm; Weight: 5.3 g


• Dimensions (case): 45.2 × 60.6 × 21.7 mm; Weight: 50.8 g


• Ingress Protection: IP54 (dust, sweat, and water resistant)Variants	Single standard variant: White (4 silicone ear tip sizes included: XS, S, M, L)
RAM / Storage	Embedded memory for firmware only (not user-accessible / standard RAM/ROM metrics do not apply)
Display	None (status LED on MagSafe case for battery/charging indications)
Processor	Apple H2 headphone chip (in earbuds) + Apple U1 chip (in MagSafe charging case for Precision Finding)
Battery Life	
• Earbuds alone: Up to 6 hours listening (up to 5.5 hours with Spatial Audio; up to 4.5 hours talk time)


• With MagSafe Case: Up to 30 hours total listening time (up to 24 hours talk time)

Charging	
• USB Type-C wired charging


• MagSafe wireless charging, Apple Watch magnetic puck charging, and Qi wireless charging


• Fast charge: 5 minutes in case provides ~1 hour listening/talk time

Cameras	None
Operating System	Firmware updates via connected iOS/iPadOS/macOS devices
Connectivity	Bluetooth 5.3, Ultra Wideband (U1 chip in case), 20-bit/48kHz Lossless Audio support with Apple Vision Pro
featuresList: Pro-level Active Noise Cancellation (up to 2x more noise reduction)
Adaptive Audio, Transparency mode & Conversation Awareness
Personalised Spatial Audio with dynamic head tracking
Touch control on stems (swipe for volume, press for playback/modes)
Built-in case speaker for Find My alerts and lanyard loop
Hearing Test and Loud Sound Reduction features
benefits: Eliminates distracting ambient noise, automatic voice/volume adjustment during chats, sweat/dust resistance (IP54 rating for both buds and case), effortless multi-device switching across Apple devices
targetCustomer: Daily commuters, remote workers, fitness enthusiasts, frequent travelers, and Apple ecosystem users seeking premium ANC and hands-free convenience
occasion: Air travel, daily transit/commute, virtual meetings and calls, gym and outdoor workouts, study sessions, immersive media viewing
tags: true wireless stereo (tws) in-ear noise-cancelling earbuds
